# ghost/xtra

Browse public Twitch game categories and live-stream listing metadata in anonymous Xtra without playback or accounts. Read visible category/viewer/broadcaster labels and stream titles/channels; never open a stream, video, clip or profile.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/xtra
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/xtra open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/xtra read_games --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/xtra open_game --device <serial> --param index=<index>
ghost skill run ghost/xtra read_streams --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/xtra back_to_games --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/xtra scroll_games --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open the public Twitch game-category list in Xtra
- `read_games`: Read complete visible game names, viewers and broadcaster labels
- `open_game`: Open a game category Live metadata list, never a stream
- `read_streams`: Read complete visible Live listing metadata without opening a stream
- `back_to_games`: Return from the category Live listing to the public game list
- `scroll_games`: Scroll the public game-category list once and read its new cards
